summary: Iter 65 — Employee Self-Service Portal tested. Backend 8/8 pytest cases pass (register unregistered→404, reset wrong→403, reset correct→200 (restored), login+me+patch+logout, mark-left disables matching user account & login now returns 403, admin login+public salon+winback regression pass). Frontend BLOCKER: EmployeePortal AuthForms & ProfileEditor use a stale-closure setState pattern that drops keystrokes at normal typing speed — the phone/aadhaar/city inputs remain empty (or lose data) so real users cannot log in / register / edit the city field through the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Stale-closure setState drops keystrokes. `const set = (k) => (e) => setF({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value })` closes over the render-time `f`; with React 18 auto-batching, rapid keystrokes on the phone / aadhaar / city inputs collapse to the last event using STALE f, so most typed characters vanish. Verified: keyboard.type('9812345670', delay=40ms) on emp-phone-input leaves input value=''; only super-slow typing (>=300ms between chars) sometimes sticks. Password input (type=password) happens to work only because it is typed last and receives one long e.target.value from the DOM in one shot. Screenshot showed 'Please fill out this field' HTML5 required-error on phone even after fully typing it. The exact same broken pattern is used in ProfileEditor (line 79) — city/name/email/current_address updates also lose keystrokes.
ui_bugs.priority: HIGH — real users cannot log in / register / reset password / edit profile through the UI

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/EmployeePortal.jsx AuthForms (line ~22) change `setF({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value })` to functional form: `setF(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: e.target.value }))` — one-line fix.
Apply the same fix to ProfileEditor onChange (line 92): `onChange={e => setF(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: e.target.value }))}`.

After fix, re-run UI test — the mark-left → salon-login-disabled flow, register-unregistered toast, edit-city persistence and logout have all been verified server-side and only need the input fix to become end-to-end verifiable in the browser.
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeePortal.jsx line 22 & 92 – classic React stale-closure with object spread. This is the exact anti-pattern React docs warn against; switch to functional updater form.

AuthForms tab buttons (line 49) have no type='button'. They are outside the <form>, so HTML doesn't submit, but adding type='button' is safer against future refactors that might move them inside the form.

current_employee helper: 401 for a missing/invalid cookie is fine, but on every page load the portal fires GET /employee/me and logs 4x 401 console errors before rendering the auth card. Consider silencing (use axios interceptor or a first-load probe with `?probe=1`).

registry_mark_left (routes/registry.py:504) only matches users by lower-cased email + tenant + role!=admin. If an admin@ email happens to also be a staff (unlikely) the disable would skip; behavior is intentional per spec.
employee_portal._find_registry_emp_by_phone (line 60) does a full-collection scan — O(N) with growth. Add an index on registry_employees.phone (last-10-digit prefix) or store normalized_phone.

rca of the issue: EmployeePortal.jsx defines `const set = (k) => (e) => setF({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value })` at render time; the closure captures `f`. React 18 batches updates for events dispatched outside React's synthetic event pipeline (or when the event loop dispatches multiple keystrokes before commit). Because each keystroke's setF re-uses the same stale `f`, only the last handler's result survives. For the phone/aadhaar inputs, the DOM value briefly shows the typed characters before the controlled input reasserts the empty state on next commit. Reproduction: page.keyboard.type('9812345670', delay=40) → input value remains ''. Fix: change to functional setState `setF(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: e.target.value }))` — this is the same anti-pattern React docs warn about (https://react.dev/reference/react/useState#ive-updated-the-state-but-logging-gives-me-the-old-value).
